projection: ParameterHashProjector random sign CountSketch over concatenated trainable LoRA gradients
budget_rule: K=max(2,ceil(N/q)) anchors per trajectory including endpoints; both policies use exactly K
block_rule: Each block is the strict interior between consecutive true-gradient anchors; endpoint anchors are excluded
representative_rule: Arithmetic mean of the two known endpoint projected gradients
comparison: Uniform versus equal-budget CRB; divide K-2 discretionary anchors equally among coverage, error-risk, recursive minimum-kappa stages
dispersion: Mean 1-cosine between each true interior projected gradient and the direction of the endpoint-mean representative
aggregation: Equal-block and interior-window-weighted means per trajectory and method
